citations.assessment: Zunin’s explanation of the local regnal count is explicit in the case about a suspected postdated document; the previous discussion gives the difference between ordinary and folded documents.
Rashbam labels Zunin as the name of a sage.
Rabbi calls the document postdated, and Zunin explains the doubled starting count. The following line confirms that Rabbi accepted the explanation.
The named Zunin enters the study house and asks about the size of stones for the privy. The passage supplies no patronymic or identification with the Zunin of another episode.
